decision.comment: Reporting stage is mechanically correct and internally consistent. All arithmetic verified: OOD aggregate AUROC (0.96231+0.970555+0.946572)/3=0.959812 ✓; OOD validation AUROC (0.996542+0.997375+0.992553)/3=0.99549 ✓; accuracy delta 0.922981−0.821309=0.101672 ✓; human-review count 7180×0.326323≈2343 ✓; confusion-matrix sums and per-class metrics consistent. No deterministic findings. ResNet18 topology is fixed (hidden=48 controls base width; depth field ignored) — consistent with pipeline rules. Generic transformer fields in the baseline tiny_cnn config are inactive for CNN families and do not constitute a hybrid. All augmentations referenced are built-in primitives requiring no extension approval. OOD evaluation is correctly scoped as a controlled corruption proxy (unit-scale Gaussian noise, 3 severities); ood_pass=true is valid within that scope and does not overstate general OOD robustness. The 7.2 pp val/test accuracy gap (99.40% vs 92.30%) propagates into a 23× selective-risk gap at 80% coverage (val 0.0011 vs test 0.0258); this is a calibration-transfer monitoring concern, not a pipeline defect. Label smoothing 0.1 and weight decay 0.001 deviate slightly from architecture-research suggestions for CNN heads but show no observed negative impact. Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall 0.620 and Class 5 (smooth muscle) F1 0.767 are the weakest per-class metrics. best_epoch=15 is the budget boundary with only 0.01 pp improvement from epoch 14→15 (plateau). The 32.6% abstention rate is a design choice; accuracy_on_covered 97.4% is strong. All anomaly-stage reviews (abstention, comparison, model_search) returned continue/ok; evaluation and reporting anomaly reviews returned revise/warning solely to flag the above monitoring items. No action-blocking issues identified. Reporting is accurate, complete, and ready for downstream consumption with the noted warnings attached.
issues: Val/test accuracy gap of ~7.2 pp (99.40% val vs 92.30% test) propagates into a 23× selective-risk gap at 80% coverage (val 0.0011 vs test 0.0258); calibration transfer should be monitored in deployment.
OOD evaluation is a controlled corruption proxy (unit-scale Gaussian noise, 3 severities); ood_pass=true is scope-limited and does not constitute a general OOD guarantee.
Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall 0.620 / F1 0.737 and Class 5 (smooth muscle) F1 0.767 are the weakest per-class metrics; 113 combined misclassifications into debris/smooth-muscle.

Label smoothing 0.1 exceeds the 0.0–0.05 CNN-head recommendation from architecture research; weight decay 0.001 is below the 0.01 suggestion. No observed negative impact but noted for reproducibility.
best_epoch=15 is the budget boundary; improvement from epoch 14→15 was only 0.01 pp (plateau), suggesting the 15-epoch budget may be insufficient for further gains.
32.6% abstention rate (2343/7180) is a design choice; accuracy_on_covered 97.4% is strong but the deferred fraction is non-trivial for operational planning.
reporting_status.complete_through_stage is 'comparison', consistent with the reporting stage being the current (not yet closed) stage; no inconsistency.
